Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As we start completing the CSA/CAIQ document there are a couple of clarification asks from our security team: 1) For a handful of controls (specifically CCM: INF-2, DATA-1, and CRY-3 equivalents in the CAIQ), can you confirm the tenant boundary and whether telemetry/log samples you provide will include tenant identifiers or redacted views? 2) We need a reproducible sample of runtime KV-cache logs and a short note on log retention/rotation for the sample window (30 days).

If you can provide a small artifact bundle (sample logs + control crosswalk table) and a confirmation on whether any control evidence is dependent on customer configuration (we'll need to note that in our submission), that would close a lot of gaps on our side.

We're targeting an internal submission by next Tuesday 6/23. Can you confirm what you can ship by COB Thursday 6/18?

Thanks,

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note. Confirming receipt and timeline: we'll aim to provide the artifact bundle by Thursday COB (6/18). Overview below and owners looped.

Quick answers up front:
- Tenant boundary: all hosted inference runs within a logically multi-tenant pool. Customers are isolated by per-request tenant ID and per-tenant KV caches; runtime telemetry and KV cache dumps we provide for assessment will be redacted unless you explicitly request tenant-tagged samples.
- Sample contents: a redacted KV-cache snapshot, an anonymized request/response latency trace, and a truncated runtime log covering a 2-hour window. Retention policy note attached.

Action items and owners:
- Priyom: produce redacted KV logs + retention note (technical appendix).
- Marissa: prepare control crosswalk spreadsheet with CAIQ control IDs and brief evidence pointers (what we provide vs. customer config).
- Neha (me): package artifacts, sign-off, and upload to shared Drive + provide DocuSign link for evidence access terms if needed.

Elena, quick Q: do you need the sample to include an anonymized tenant mapping table (we can provide but it requires a short legal/data share exception)? If not, we'll redact tenant ids.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Forwarding the initial ask and dropping technical notes below.

Technical appendix (for inclusion in the artifact bundle):
- KV-cache snapshot: will be exported from the serving runtime with tenant identifiers replaced by stable pseudonyms (hash-PRFX-XXXX). We will include a mapping file only if Novamed signs the short data sharing exception.
- Runtime logs: we will truncate to non-sensitive fields (timestamps, request size, model id, opcode traces). No raw prompt content will be included.
- Retention: primary telemetry retained for 90 days hot and archived for 365 days; customer-facing audit trails (request id, timestamp, outcome) retained 180 days by default.
- Controls dependency: AUTH-2 and KMS-3 controls require customer KMS configuration for full compliance; we'll flag these as "customer-config-dependent" in the crosswalk.

Attachments I'll add to the package: novamed_sample_kv_logs.txt (redacted), redwood_hosting_boundary_diagram.pdf.

Priyom Das
Sr. Security Engineer
